meta.title: Decision-readiness register — questions, information, answers
meta.rule: Every question that must be answered before any decision (capital, implementation or reward) can be reasonably made. Have = answered from verified data; Partial = partly answered with a named gap; Missing = no verified answer exists, the answer cell stays blank and a discovery suggestion is recorded. No answer is ever inferred.

rows.question: Can the current model beat the closing line?
rows.information_needed: Out-of-sample accuracy of our spread vs the closing spread; incremental information test
rows.answer: No. Model MAE 10.39 vs market 9.71 (n=936, 2023-2026); incremental coefficient -0.019, p=0.881; Brier skill vs market -0.038 (n=2,687).
rows.discovery_suggestion: Keep the walk-forward log running each week; re-test after any feature that carries genuinely new information (e.g. verified injury/depth signals once built).

rows.question: Has any strategy passed validation gates anywhere in the repository?
rows.information_needed: Gate outcomes for every strategy family across all labs
rows.answer: No. Root: 0 of 9 (7 strategies + 2 controls, best 5/10). Skill-lab: 0 of 16 (best 6/10). Quant-lab: 0 of 21. Origination-lab: 0 eligible (best 3 of 7). Pipeline: 0 of 5 (six gates).
rows.discovery_suggestion: Continue gated paper tracking; do not relax gates to manufacture a pass (SG-12).

rows.question: Are same-game parlay legs independent?
rows.information_needed: Empirical joint vs product probabilities for shared-driver legs
rows.answer: No. QB-WR1 r=0.56-0.61; 4-leg same-team joint 11.1% vs 5.7% product; copula multipliers 1.26x-2.05x on correlated stacks.
rows.discovery_suggestion: Price same-game tickets with the correlation-aware table, never with multiplied legs (SG-14).

rows.question: Which correlation matrix is canonical for pricing?
rows.information_needed: One pre-registered matrix with fixed window, definitions and role labels
rows.answer: Three measured matrices exist (root 2012-2026 designation series; skill-lab 2018-2026 ex-ante and ex-post; quant-lab game-level phi). No single one has been declared canonical.
rows.discovery_suggestion: Pre-register one matrix per pricing use-case (game markets vs player props), publish the definition with every coefficient (SG-08).

rows.question: Is there a verified historical player-prop price feed?
rows.information_needed: Closing (and ideally opening) prop prices with settlement timestamps
rows.discovery_suggestion: Ask the league's data-distribution partner / licensed data vendors for a licensed historical odds feed; until then every prop ROI stays blank and prop strategies stay paper (no price, no ROI).

rows.question: Are opening lines available for CLV measurement?
rows.information_needed: Opening prices at a known timestamp for each market
rows.discovery_suggestion: Same acquisition route as Q-05; alternatively record our own odds snapshots prospectively from a licensed board and wait for settlement (a forward-only CLV log).

rows.question: Which injury/availability data is officially published?
rows.information_needed: League-official player status per week, per club
rows.answer: The official weekly injury report (nfl.com/injuries/league/<year>/REGn) publishes Player, Position, Injuries, Practice Status and Game Status for all 32 clubs. Verified live for Week 10 2026.
rows.discovery_suggestion: Ingest this report weekly at a fixed timestamp (before kickoff) and store it point-in-time (SG-13).

rows.question: How can 2nd/3rd/4th-string deficiencies be determined without official depth charts?
rows.information_needed: A defensible, pre-registered definition of starter vs backup per unit (offense/defense)
rows.discovery_suggestion: Define role tiers by usage: e.g. season snap-share rank within position-group from the official play-by-play-derived snap feeds (third-party redistribution), cross-checked against club-published depth charts where clubs publish them (verified example: colts.com). Label every tier as inferred; keep the official depth-string cell blank.

rows.question: Is there verified execution access, with limits and jurisdiction?
rows.information_needed: A licensed operator account, jurisdiction, market access, limits and fill policy
rows.discovery_suggestion: Verify jurisdiction and account before any capital decision; record the operator rulebook edition actually in force (see the archived-edition flag); treat gates G8/G9 as unclosable until then.

rows.question: Is the leaderboard reward pool funded?
rows.information_needed: A funding source and accounting for any prize
rows.answer: No. All published schedules are paper (skill-lab cash_funding cells are empty). The only official precedent found is the NFL Big Data Bowl 2027 ($45k Open + $45k University + $10k Grand Prize).
rows.discovery_suggestion: Decide funding explicitly before advertising rewards; if unfunded, label every schedule 'paper' in the same typeface as the numbers (SG-04).

rows.question: Which of the four published reward schedules is canonical?
rows.information_needed: One tier structure, one unit, one gate requirement per tier
rows.answer: Four schemes exist (root 3-tier; skill-lab 4-tier points; origination-lab pool-share; suggestions 3-tier). None chosen.
rows.discovery_suggestion: Adopt the BDB-style structure adapted to gates (Gold = 10/10 + skill score, Silver = 10/10, Bronze = 9/10 incl. mandatory G1/G3/G5/G6/G10) as proposed in SG-04, and retire the others to the archive.

rows.question: Which settlement rules apply to pushes, ties and voids?
rows.information_needed: The operator rulebook edition in force for each market
rows.answer: Push handling (stake returned, removed from denominators) is implemented per the cited operator rulebook, but the cited edition (8.1.24) is archived; the active edition (10.7.26) could not be text-verified in the sandbox.
rows.discovery_suggestion: Fetch and re-read the active rulebook PDF text from a machine that can; pin the edition hash in the register (SG-07).

rows.question: Is the data provenance reproducible end to end?
rows.information_needed: Hashed raw inputs, deterministic builds, independent recomputation
rows.answer: Yes. Manifest records sizes and SHA-256 per extract (28/31 byte-match upstream on 2026-11-12); builds are deterministic; the independent recomputation reports 49 checks with 0 disagreements.
rows.discovery_suggestion: Keep the PR-based refresh (post issue-#20) and re-run the byte-compare each refresh cycle (SG-10).

rows.question: What edge ceiling does public data support for player props?
rows.information_needed: Forecast skill vs naive baselines at the median line
rows.answer: Projection skill is about +2% MAE vs a season-mean baseline (root props.json: 0.5-0.8% improvement fields on the calibrated medians; the published summary states ~+2% vs last-5). No prop ROI can be computed without prices (Q-05).
rows.discovery_suggestion: Treat +2% as the ceiling until better inputs (route-level tracking, official depth) exist; never translate it into expected ROI without a price feed.

rows.question: Is there an untouched holdout anywhere?
rows.information_needed: One declared holdout period, touched once, per lab
rows.answer: Yes per lab: root holdout 2025-2026; quant-lab discovery 2002-2019 / holdout 2020-2026; skill-lab holdout 2024-2026. The split definitions differ across labs.
rows.discovery_suggestion: Declare one canonical split repo-wide before the next strategy wave (SG-03) so leaderboard rows are comparable.

rows.question: Are weather inputs complete enough for the weather signals?
rows.information_needed: Stadium-level game-time wind and temperature coverage
rows.answer: Coverage is about 57% of games (suggestions hub flag FL-09); NWS values can be preliminary (NOWData note). The wind-under signal is the most-tested weather angle in four labs.
rows.discovery_suggestion: Backfill stadium coordinates + archived game-time observations (NWS API), stamp each observation with its retrieval time, and re-run the wind-under decay curve before any decision.

rows.question: Are player role labels (WR1 etc.) point-in-time?
rows.information_needed: Role designation as known before kickoff, not ex-post game leaders
rows.answer: Partly. Skill-lab enforces a zero-lookahead gate (G1) and labels ex-ante vs ex-post series (r 0.372 vs 0.614); the root KPI series uses the WR1 designation. No official pre-kickoff depth source exists (Q-08).
rows.discovery_suggestion: Build the role tier from prior-week usage + roster data, freeze it at kickoff, and publish both series with explicit labels (SG-08).

rows.question: What vig does each market charge?
rows.information_needed: Per-market overround at the recorded prices
rows.answer: Mean spread overround 2.7% is measured on priced games (root market.json); per-book margins are not published by operators and stay blank (root FL-04).
rows.discovery_suggestion: Compute the overround directly from each stored price pair going forward and record it per game; leave per-operator margins blank unless the operator publishes them.

rows.question: What is the multiple-testing policy for the strategy family?
rows.information_needed: One correction method, one q, applied to the whole family
rows.answer: Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 across the tested family (root n_tests 9; skill-lab q 0.10; origination-lab 27 tests), plus a deflated-Sharpe max-of-k check.
rows.discovery_suggestion: Keep the family definition in one file so new strategies extend the family before testing (SG-09).

rows.question: Which site should a reader treat as canonical?
rows.information_needed: One landing place for decisions, with sibling labs as archives
rows.answer: Not yet decided. The root Line Lab is the most complete integrated dashboard; eight sibling hubs publish overlapping sections (I-04).
rows.discovery_suggestion: Adopt the root Line Lab as canonical and link this hub (decisions) plus the sibling labs from the archive page — proposed as SG-01 for the owner to approve.
